primary_claim: Chat finetuning on synthetic data effectively instills target traits in Gemini 3 Flash robustly and out-of-distribution, while midtraining on synthetic pretraining-style documents improves most (but not all) OOD safety evals and often stacks with SFT.

effect.metric: OOD safety eval scores vs baseline (SFT-only, midtraining)

contradicts_or_qualifies: removing emotionally validating openings from synthetic SFT data did not reduce delusion confirmation, which the authors say is some evidence against the intuition that validation buffering leads to delusion validation
stated_future_work: explore each midtraining takeaway further and quantify the extent to which they are necessary for the success of midtraining
limitations_stated: we generally didn't run comprehensive ablations for the midtraining takeaways
it was more difficult to tweak hyperparameters of BDPO for training stability
we spent many FTE weeks unable to get positive results from midtraining, frequently experiencing severe capability regressions
we didn't test the benefit of holistic trait documents with ablations
quote: The chat finetuning is effective for instilling the traits robustly, working OOD.
